summary: DevRelay has released planning and assignment modules, a provider-neutral WorkExecution contract slice, and a dogfood-ready WorkItemVerification slice. ChangeIntegration is the missing effect boundary that incorporates one exactly verified change before Core recalculates the ready frontier.
stakeholders: System verification and business acceptance reviewers
domainConstraints: Only a Gate-approved WorkItemVerification result can enter ChangeIntegration.
V1 targets one configured local Git ref and expected commit per invocation.
Core serializes target updates through compare-and-swap; target drift cannot be silently rebased.
Integration conflicts are evidence, not permission to alter the verified change or target automatically.
Only integrated completion may unlock the next dependency frontier; system verification remains later.
conventions: Use SHA-256-bound artifacts, raw bytes, exact semantic versions, and Git object identities at every boundary.
Separate verification approval, integration effect, system verification, and business acceptance.
Preserve every failed attempt, conflict set, target observation, effect receipt, and replay checkpoint.
Represent host permissions as explicit demands and require the host to enforce them.
Prove success, conflict, drift, invalid-subject, partial-effect recovery, retry, and zero-call replay paths.
